messages.text:
At Glamour Studio, we offer haircut services starting at $25. Each haircut includes a wash and takes about 30 minutes.

While we don't have a separate "premium" tier listed, our standard haircut service gives you a quality cut with a complimentary wash included. It's a straightforward, great-value option.

We're open Mondays from 9am to 6pm, so you can easily fit an appointment into your schedule. Would you like to book a haircut with us?
